card.name: Atsiagbekor
card.era: Derived from the war dance Atamga; modern cultural-performance form
card.tagline: Ewe war dance, modern variant of Agbekor/Atamga
card.profile: Atsiagbekor is a traditional war dance of the Ewe people, originating in Ghana's Volta Region and extending to Togo and Benin (Wikipedia). It traces to the war dance Atamga and was historically performed in platoon formations reflecting reconnaissance, surprise attacks and combat maneuvers, with the Atimavu master drum leading an ensemble of drummers, dancers and singers. Today it is performed at social gatherings, festivals and educational institutions, notably by the Ghana Dance Ensemble at the University of Ghana (Wikipedia).
card.insight: Educational centers such as the Dagbe Cultural Center in Kopeyia teach Atsiagbekor, and the Ghana Dance Ensemble has showcased it on global stages (Wikipedia).
